items.prompt: Which word is right for the picture?
hints: How many animals are in the picture?
More than one needs an ending.
Most words just add one letter.
items.explanation: There are 3 cats. For more than one cat, we add s: cats.

options.why: Cat is for one. There are more than one.
We only add s to cat.

items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'One dog, two ___.'
hints: Two means more than one.
Add an ending to show more than one.
Most words just add one letter.
items.explanation: For more than one dog, add s: dogs.

options.why: We only add s to dog.

hints: Say each word for more than one.
Words that end in s, x, sh or ch add -es.
Start with box. Say two boxes. Can you hear the extra sound?
items.explanation: Bus, box and dish add -es: buses, boxes, dishes. Cup, hat and pen just add -s.

items.prompt: Write the word for more than one box.
hints: Box ends with x.
Words that end with x add -es.
Write box first, then add the ending.
items.explanation: Box ends with x, so we add -es: boxes.

items.prompt: Add -ing to jump. Which is right?
hints: Start with the word jump.
Do not change any letters in jump.
Write jump, then add the ending.
items.explanation: Jump plus -ing is jumping. We just add -ing.

options.why: Jump ends with two consonants. Just add -ing.
There is no e in jump. Just add -ing.

items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'The baby is ___.'
hints: Look at the word before the gap.
Is tells us it is happening now.
Try each word in the sentence.
items.explanation: We say 'The baby is sleeping.' After is, we use the -ing word.

options.why: Try it: The baby is sleeps. It does not sound right.
Try it: The baby is sleep. It does not sound right.

items.prompt: Add -ing to read. Write the new word.
hints: Keep the word read the same.
Add the ending -ing.
Write read first.

items.prompt: Match one to more than one.
hints: Look at the start of each word.
Some words add -s and some add -es.
Start with fox. Find the word that starts with fox.
items.explanation: Fox and brush add -es. Bird and tree add -s.

hints: How many are in the picture?
Bus ends with s.
Words that end with s add -es.
items.explanation: Bus ends with s, so for more than one we add -es: buses.

options.why: Bus ends with s, so we add -es.
Bus is for one. There are two.

items.prompt: Choose all the words that add -es.
hints: Three words add -es.
Look at the last letters: s, x, sh, ch.
Check the end of each word.
items.explanation: Dish, fox and watch add -es: dishes, foxes, watches.

hints: Three means more than one.
Box ends with x.
Check the ending and the word before three.
items.explanation: There are three boxes is correct. Box adds -es, and more than one uses are.

options.why: Box ends with x, so it adds -es.
For more than one, we say there are.

items.prompt: Add -ing to play. 'The children are ___ in the rain.'
hints: Are tells us it is happening now.
Keep play the same.
Write play, then add the ending.
items.explanation: Play plus -ing makes playing: The children are playing in the rain.

items.prompt: Add -ing to swim. How is it spelt?
hints: Swim is a short word with one vowel.
Short words like this often double the last letter.
Think of run and running.
items.explanation: Swim has one short vowel and ends with m. We double the m and add -ing: swimming.

options.why: There is no e in swim.
That has too many m letters.
